title: SecurityGroup
description: A security group that controls access to securable items within Workday domains and business processes. Security groups can be role-based, user-based, integration system-based, or derived from job or organizational criteria.

id.description: Unique identifier for the security group

descriptor.description: Human-readable name of the security group

type.description: Classification of the security group that determines how membership is derived and managed

description.description: Detailed description of the security group purpose

inactive.description: Whether the security group is currently inactive

memberCount.description: Number of members currently in the security group

domainPolicies.description: Domain security policies associated with this security group

createdOn.description: Timestamp when the security group was created

lastModified.description: Timestamp when the security group was last modified
